sloka: सुमन्त्रः अपि अवतीर्य एव मोचयित्वा हय उत्तमान् ।वृक्ष मूल गतम् रामम् उपतस्थे कृत अन्जलिः ॥२-५०-३२॥
transliteration: sumantraḥ api avatīrya eva mocayitvā haya uttamān ।vṛkṣa mūla gatam rāmam upatasthe kṛta anjaliḥ ॥2-50-32॥

translations.english: Sumantra too descended, unyoked the excellent horses, and waited with joined palms upon Rama, who was seated at the foot of the tree.
